scenarios.title: Mixed sidebar attention states
scenarios.purpose: Tests bold names, teal waiting states, numeric counts, neutral progress and dated absence in one roster.
expectedChecks: Only names with new information are bold
Only rows that wait for the member use teal
A number counts waiting objects only
Away state remains neutral and readable
Long status text truncates without horizontal scrolling

scenarios.title: Career range and profile density
scenarios.purpose: Compares an early-career paralegal, a mid-career counsel and senior of-counsel profiles without changing the component model.
expectedChecks: Every person uses the same profile structure
A person without a jurisdiction does not show an empty placeholder
Long practice lists wrap without changing avatar alignment
Experience and age remain fixture data and are not shown unless the surface explicitly requests them
Role, area, record and availability remain distinct

scenarios.title: Paralegal-to-associate contract handoff
scenarios.purpose: Tests visible handoff of work between people without turning the conversation into a duplicate assignment.

assignment.outcome: Deliver a playbook-based mark-up and an authority-complete signature packet.

expectedChecks: The assignment has one owner
The thread and assignment have separate states
Lena's administrative decision scope is not presented as legal authority
The waiting state names the person and the missing decision

scenarios.title: Sensitive investigation with limited visibility
scenarios.purpose: Tests long role text, restricted matter membership, a sourced chronology and a work product returned once.

assignment.outcome: Deliver a findings memorandum that separates allegation, evidence, credibility and conclusion.

workProduct.title: Findings memorandum
workProduct.returnReason: Two credibility conclusions lacked direct links to interview evidence.

expectedChecks: Restricted membership is visible without a warning-style badge
The returned prior version remains in history
Version 2 is the only current card
Evidence is one step away from the result

scenarios.title: Privacy incident with a real second-key decision
scenarios.purpose: Tests a decision card for an irreversible external notification without approval theatre on earlier work.

assignment.outcome: Determine whether notice is required and prepare the supported notification package.

decision.question: Send the supported notification package before the shortest applicable deadline?

expectedChecks: Only the irreversible notification asks for the second key
The evidence and exact external change are visible
Earlier evidence gathering is not presented as a chain of approvals
The holder of each key is named

scenarios.title: Argument conflicts with the evidentiary record
scenarios.purpose: Tests a senior reviewer returning work with a precise reason and a junior owner continuing the same assignment.

assignment.outcome: Deliver a motion outline supported by admissible evidence and controlling authority.

return.reason: The proposed causation argument relies on a fact that appears only in an unsworn interview note.
return.requiredChange: Replace the unsupported proposition or obtain record evidence.

expectedChecks: Returned is a work state, not a personal rating
The reason and next action are plain
Ownership stays with Noah
Priya appears as reviewer, not automatic assignee

scenarios.title: Unknown and intentionally empty profile values
scenarios.purpose: Tests honest language for backend values that have not been established.
expectedChecks: Unknown numbers never render as zero
No dash is used as a substitute for missing data
A missing record is not presented as poor performance
The recovery or refresh path is available where relevant

scenarios.title: Long copy at the minimum supported window
scenarios.purpose: Stresses wrapping and truncation at 1200 by 720 with realistic legal role names and statuses.
statusLines: Independent second-key review of the proposed appellate filing waits for you
Waiting for the client to confirm the transaction tax assumption
Government response strategy is ready for the Matter team
expectedChecks: No accidental horizontal scrolling
Names and avatars remain aligned
Role lines wrap or truncate predictably
The primary action stays visible
No layout shift occurs when a status line appears

scenarios.title: Cross-practice acquisition matter
scenarios.purpose: Tests several specialists working in one Matter while each keeps a distinct role, area and assignment.

assignments.outcome: Set the transaction structure and resolve issues that affect value or closing certainty.
Deliver the privacy diligence findings with evidence and proposed protections.
Confirm the tax assumptions embedded in the proposed structure.
Maintain the closing checklist and authority-complete signature packet.

expectedChecks: People appear together without ranking by seniority in the roster
Each assignment has one owner and can have contributors
The Matter header can show several members without becoming an avatar wall
No person is asked to coordinate the whole team through a board

scenarios.title: Avatar crop and fallback check
scenarios.purpose: Verifies all generated portraits at sidebar, thread and profile sizes.
expectedChecks: Eyes and face remain inside a circular crop
The solid background contains no office or object detail
Hair and shoulders do not touch the circle unpredictably
The image does not stretch or shift while loading
Initials provide a stable fallback if an image fails
